cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says three or more health systems exchange data; the national platform carries one use case and not all systems are connected. No national identifier link is reported.
cells.note: The health ministry says the national interoperability platform already interconnects the universal health coverage enrolment and billing systems (CMR-002), two systems in use. It names no third system connected and says the rest are not yet, so not 4.
